## What are we changing?

Tell us what changed in normal-person language.

## What problem does this solve?

What was confusing, broken, outdated, inaccessible, duplicated, or otherwise making life harder?

## What did you test?

Check whatever applies:

- [ ] Desktop
- [ ] Mobile
- [ ] Keyboard only
- [ ] 200% zoom / reflow
- [ ] Screen reader
- [ ] JavaScript disabled where relevant
- [ ] Resource data still comes from the canonical record
- [ ] Crisis information is still easy to find
- [ ] No private mutual-aid information is included

## Anything weird we should know?

Sources, screenshots, edge cases, things that still need verification, or "this works but I hate this one CSS thing" all belong here.
